bullets.title: TSMC 3Q Beat & AI Demand: Key Semiconductor Derivative Plays
bullets.body: TSMC posted 3Q revenue of $46.7bn (vs $45.4bn est), guided Q4 to $53.3bn midpoint (vs $50.1bn est), and raised FY26 growth to +44% YoY. N2 capacity expected to more than double in CY27; HPC now 68% of revenue. Despite the beat, gross margin of 66.4% missed 67.1% consensus, and overseas fab expansion will add 300-400bps of margin headwind over 5 years. NVDA, AVGO, MRVL identified as primary beneficiaries of AI accelerator demand with mid-to-high 50% CAGR.

bullets.title: CoreWeave Debt Stress Triggers Broad AI/Semi De-Grossing
bullets.body: CRWV plunged 17% on debt concerns (bonds trading ~78¢, yields >15%); Hedgeye holds CRWV, IREN, NBIS as core shorts. Broad hedge fund de-grossing of -1.3std US equities hit the AI complex -1.9std; NBIS -11%, DELL -12%, COHR -8.9%, CRDO -8.5%, ANET -5%, ORCL -8.3%. IMF warned $300B equity + $650B debt pledged against $1.4T promised AI revenue poses systemic risk; Gartner flagged $3.5T AI infrastructure impairment risk by 2030.

bullets.title: MSFT: Constructive into Earnings; PT Raised to $600 by Mizuho
bullets.body: UBS's Karl Keirstead remains constructive on MSFT at 23x CY27 non-GAAP EPS with Azure 44-45% CC guidance leaving upside room as AI demand outstrips supply. Mizuho raises PT to $600 from $510 on higher multiples. Jefferies expects M365 Commercial acceleration and strong Azure beat. CIO survey shows accelerating cyber spend with MSFT as a primary beneficiary.

bullets.title: GOOGL/AMZN: JPM Raises Cloud Estimates Ahead of Earnings
bullets.body: JPM raises GOOGL Cloud growth to +100% in 3Q26 and +107% in 2027 on TPU inclusion; PT raised $420→$425, Overweight maintained. AMZN AWS modeled at +42% 3Q (vs street +37%) with 2027 growth to +40%; 2027 OI guidance expected $30-35B, $1-2B above street. JPM's street-high AMZN 2027 EPS range $11.50-$12.50 vs street ~$11.

bullets.title: META: $10B Legal Accrual & Muse AI Capex Weigh on 2027 EPS
bullets.body: META faces a $10B legal expense accrual in 3Q26 for settlement with 52 state AGs, pushing 2027E total GAAP expenses to $210B (+18% YoY). Oppenheimer and OPCO model FY27/28 EPS ~10% below consensus on Muse AI capex; $135B cumulative FCF losses through 2028 vs ~$90B cash raises equity issuance risk. JPM upgraded META to Overweight with $920 PT on 26x '28E EPS of $35.45; Muse regained #1 iOS App Store position.

bullets.title: NFLX: Jefferies Assumes Buy at $85 PT; 10 Years of 14%+ EPS Growth
bullets.body: Jefferies cuts NFLX PT to $85 from $90 but maintains Buy, citing 10 years of 14%+ EPS CAGR from monetization, margin expansion, and buybacks. The stock trades at 18x FY27E EPS vs 27x historical average; sentiment improving on US price hikes, higher ad rates, and 6% workforce reduction (~1k roles). Hedgeye's Risk Range signals NFLX as Bearish with sell level $72. Earnings due October 20.

bullets.title: SPOT: Downgraded to Hold at StoneX Ahead of Oct 22 Earnings
bullets.body: StoneX downgrades SPOT from Buy to Hold citing challenging near-term financials. Goldman favors SPOT as a scaled distributor in music (5.8% CAGR 2025-35) over rights holders. 3Q operational tracking shows 305M Premium subs and 788M MAUs on target; near-term debate centers on 4Q revenue/margin expectations vs. innovation investment. Earnings October 22 pre-market.

bullets.title: ACN: Analyst Day Shows Accelerating 2027-29 Revenue Outlook
bullets.body: Accenture's analyst day showed CC revenue growth reaching mid-to-high single digits in FY29 vs mid-single digits in FY27-28. ACN identified 20 AI-driven growth areas that could double revenue share from 6% to 12% by FY29, with a $1B agentic commerce pipeline and 50 large-scale data/AI deals. UBS and Jefferies reiterate Buy; well-positioned for transformational AI programs.

bullets.title: CRDO: AI Campus Shift Drives Multi-Building Demand; 1.6T DSP Share Opportunity
bullets.body: CRDO is positioned to gain 1.6T DSP share with NeoCloud and Oracle as multi-building AI campus buildouts drive coherent-lite and OCS demand. ZF Optics passed NVDA qualification. JPM's OCP takeaways highlight CRDO transitioning from microLED to micro-VCSEL for ALCs with initial Microsoft and Oracle shipments expected in 2027. Memory disaggregation seen as a $10B+ market opportunity.

bullets.title: ANET/COHR/LITE: OCP Conference Confirms AI Network Optics Secular Trend
bullets.body: Wolfe Research bullish on ANET, LITE, COHR, and CIEN post-OCP; GPU utilization and optics-over-copper secular trends intact. OCS market expected to reach ~$12B by 2030 with >50% from non-Google customers; Ethernet switching growing 40%+ annually. Celestica and Arista ceding some Meta share but TAM growth sustains revenue trajectory.

bullets.title: NOW/TEAM: Mizuho Raises PTs; SaaS Checks Positive into 3Q
bullets.body: Mizuho raises NOW PT to $170 from $140 and TEAM PT to $235 from $215 on strong cloud/consumption checks and AI adoption; TEAM trades at 17-18x CY28E FCF with better-than-expected checks for the third consecutive quarter. Wolfe SaaS index at 6.2x FY+2 EV/Sales, 40% below 3-year average. NOW denied interest in acquiring Decagon.

bullets.title: MU/Memory Complex: Broad Selling on CXMT Progress & Smartphone Weakness
bullets.body: MU down 4.3% pre-market alongside WDC -5.7%, STX -5.5%, SNDK -5.2% amid storage sector weakness. Global smartphone shipments fell 22% YoY in 3Q26 (worst quarter on record) due to AI-led memory cost surge. Jefferies warns CXMT's 4F² DRAM still lags Korean competitors, making US hyperscaler qualification unlikely; Micron's competitive moat remains intact near-term but Chinese competition a medium-term risk.

bullets.title: NVDA/TSLA: Hedgeye Downgrades Both from Bullish to Neutral
bullets.body: Hedgeye's Risk Range signals cut NVDA and TSLA from Bullish to Neutral as the AI complex deleverages. JPM remains Tactically Bullish on Semis/Tech into earnings with SOX ~20% off July lows; retail investors buying NVDA dips. NVDA CEO warned he would halt chip supply to customers developing unsafe AI.

bullets.title: FOXA/ROKU: Shareholder Vote Clears; DOJ Second Request Extends Review to H1 2027
bullets.body: Roku shareholders approved Fox's $160/share acquisition ($96 cash + 0.9693 FOXA shares per ROKU share; $22B EV). DOJ issued a Second Request extending the HSR waiting period; Fox expects close in H1 2027. Pro forma combined entity would be the third-largest US television player with ~$400M run-rate cost synergies and FCF/share accretion by year 2 post-close.

bullets.title: GFS: Wolfe Upgrades to Outperform $85 PT on US-Japan Fab Deal
bullets.body: Wolfe upgrades GFS to Outperform with $85 PT (74% upside from $48.94) after GFS announced a $21B US-Japan government-funded Malta NY expansion. GFS bears no capital financing risk; long-term annual contribution includes 100-200bps GM accretion and $0.50-$0.75 EPS accretion. GFS can redeploy $955M in CHIPS Act funding toward SiPho, SiGe, and advanced packaging.

bullets.title: CSCO: MS OW $135 PT; CIO Survey Shows Campus Refresh Intact Despite Moderation
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley maintains Overweight on CSCO at $135 PT; net spend intentions declined to +28% from +57% but CSCO leads Arista (+25%) and HPE/Juniper (+13%). Campus switching spending rose to +50% and upgrade intentions improved to +36%. Data center purchase intentions eased but CSCO leads peers. 20% of orders impacted by macro (up from ~12%) and project delays jumped to 13% from 2%.

bullets.title: AMZN Q3 Preview: AWS +42% Y/Y Bogey; $28B OI vs $26.5B Guide High-End
bullets.body: JPM previews AMZN Q3 with AWS growth bogey at +42% Y/Y vs street +37%, implying easy beat-and-raise. Q3 OI expected ~$28B vs guidance high of $26.5B. 2027 AWS capex range of $320-375B vs street ~$280B; 2027 EPS investor range $11.50-$12.50 vs street ~$11. Jefferies bullish on AWS acceleration and resilient ecom segment.

bullets.title: Macro: Hot September Core CPI (0.335% MoM) Spooks AI Credit; 10Y at 5.08-5.19%
bullets.body: September core CPI printed 0.335% MoM, well above the 0.2% street estimate, briefly pushing Oct Fed hike odds above 50% before fading to ~32%. High-yield OAS widened +11bps in one day, +59bps over the past month. The 10Y yield ultimately reversed lower to 5.08-5.19%, suggesting markets shifting focus from inflation to growth destruction risk as real wages fell 0.7% YoY.

bullets.title: GEV: Venture Global Agreements for 16 New 720 MW Power Units Supporting 10 GW AI Compute
bullets.body: Venture Global secured power frame agreements with GE Vernova and Baker Hughes for up to 16 new 720 MW power island units, supporting up to 10 GW of compute capacity at company-owned sites by 2034. First power island purchase order expected by end of 2026. The off-grid Island Mode power model uses on-site gas generation with no additional public grid demand.

bullets.title: EQIX: Capacity Pull-Forward from 2027 into 2026; Hybrid Cloud & Agentic AI Tailwind
bullets.body: Equinix accelerated meaningful capacity from 2027 into 2026 and is exploring bringing 2028 capacity forward to 2027. Jefferies and Wolfe highlight EQIX as a beneficiary of hybrid cloud enterprise investments and expanding agentic AI for enterprise. The stock is Buy-rated on data center structural tailwinds.
